notes: PROVISIONAL defaults pending a calibration pilot (docs/regime.md).
No model default: the runner refuses to launch without --model.

instances null = the 15 cells of the paper's design: atlas-advisory, gigbridge-marketplace, northwind-analytics, sprout-crm, voltcore-devices x soft, hard, hostile. The other 15 briefs (10 companies x 3 tiers in data/eval1/tasks) are valid optional instances.
max_turns 30 is the primary budget, set generously so that it is not the binding constraint.

wall_clock_s 2400 and usd_rail 2.0 are rails (a trial that hits one is scored, never retried). 2400 s is the paper's extended backfill timeout (BWM_PLANNER_TIMEOUT). usd_rail 2.0 is the paper's --max-budget-usd 2.
query_budget: the paper enforced none (grounded-readonly and grounded-iterate differed by one prompt sentence). v1 enforces 3 run_model calls server-side for grounded-readonly (ledger E1-D14).
